pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Variable-sized dark brownish polygonal regions characterized by high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. Geometry transitions from large, elongated patches on the mid-flank to smaller, more fragmented and circular speckles along the ventral midline and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored negative space. The topology is defined by a dense web of Y-junction and X-junction nodes with varying pixel-thickness (approx. 5-30 pixels) throughout the flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Serrated 1D silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder mane, showing consistent high-frequency tufting and irregular amplitude against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent anatomical protrusion/bulge is visible at the junction of the lower neck and the pectoral region.
